# vyos.blueprints.management

Management plane - SNMP, traps, syslog, NTP, RADIUS login

- Configures the services a router needs to be monitored and administered.
- SNMP, syslog and NTP use vyos.vyos resource modules. RADIUS login uses vyos.vyos.vyos_config because vyos.vyos has no resource module for `system login radius` yet.
- Overlaps with `base` for syslog and NTP; configure them in one role only.
- Secrets (communities, keys) are masked in `vyos_blueprints_rendered`.

## Usage

```yaml
- hosts: routers
  gather_facts: false
  roles:
    - vyos.blueprints.management
```

## Variables

| Variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `management_snmp` | dict |  |  | SNMP agent settings. Omit to leave SNMP untouched. |
| `management_snmp.contact` | str |  |  | sysContact. |
| `management_snmp.location` | str |  |  | sysLocation. |
| `management_snmp.description` | str |  |  | sysDescr. |
| `management_snmp.listen_addresses` | list |  | `[]` | Addresses the agent listens on (default port). |
| `management_snmp.communities` | list |  | `[]` | SNMPv2c communities. |
| `management_snmp.communities.name` | str | yes |  | Community string. |
| `management_snmp.communities.authorization` | str |  | `ro` | Access level. |
| `management_snmp.communities.clients` | list |  | `[]` | Hosts allowed to use this community. |
| `management_snmp.communities.networks` | list |  | `[]` | Networks allowed to use this community. |
| `management_snmp.trap_source` | str |  |  | Source address for traps. |
| `management_snmp.trap_targets` | list |  | `[]` | SNMPv2c trap receivers. Configured with vyos.vyos.vyos_config because vyos.vyos.vyos_snmp_server drops the community and port of a trap target and supports only one. |
| `management_snmp.trap_targets.address` | str | yes |  | Receiver address. |
| `management_snmp.trap_targets.community` | str |  |  | Community sent with traps. |
| `management_snmp.trap_targets.port` | int |  |  | Receiver port. |
| `management_snmp.v3` | dict |  |  | SNMPv3 settings, passed through unchanged as the `snmp_v3` option of vyos.vyos.vyos_snmp_server (users, groups, views, trap_targets, engine_id). |
| `management_syslog_hosts` | list |  | `[]` | Remote syslog destinations. |
| `management_syslog_hosts.host` | str | yes |  | Syslog server hostname or address. |
| `management_syslog_hosts.port` | int |  |  | Destination port. |
| `management_syslog_hosts.protocol` | str |  |  | Transport protocol. |
| `management_syslog_hosts.facility` | str |  | `all` | Facility to forward. |
| `management_syslog_hosts.level` | str |  | `info` | Minimum severity to forward. |
| `management_ntp_servers` | list |  | `[]` | NTP server hostnames or addresses. |
| `management_radius` | dict |  |  | RADIUS authentication for CLI/SSH logins. Omit to leave it untouched. Keep a local user as fallback; RADIUS-only lockouts are hard to recover. |
| `management_radius.servers` | list | yes |  | RADIUS servers, tried in order. |
| `management_radius.servers.address` | str | yes |  | Server address. |
| `management_radius.servers.key` | str | yes |  | Shared secret. |
| `management_radius.servers.port` | int |  |  | Authentication port (VyOS default 1812). |
| `management_radius.servers.timeout` | int |  |  | Query timeout in seconds. |
| `management_radius.servers.disable` | bool |  | `false` | Keep the server configured but unused. |
| `management_radius.source_address` | str |  |  | Source address for RADIUS queries. |
| `management_radius.vrf` | str |  |  | VRF used to reach the servers. |
| `vyos_blueprints_render_only` | bool |  | `false` | Collect commands into `vyos_blueprints_rendered` instead of configuring. |

## Entry point `verify` (`tasks_from: verify`)

Run with `tasks_from=verify`. Uses the same inputs as `main`. Checks that every configured item is present in the committed configuration.

| Variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `management_snmp` | dict |  |  | Same value as for `main`. |
| `management_syslog_hosts` | list |  | `[]` | Same value as for `main`. |
| `management_ntp_servers` | list |  | `[]` | Same value as for `main`. |
| `management_radius` | dict |  |  | Same value as for `main`. |
